component.name: Desktop Themes
component.summary: Create, preview and apply themes for LXQt and Openbox

description.p: Desktop Themes changes the whole look of an LXQt desktop in one step: Qt and GTK applications, Openbox window decorations, the panel, icons, cursor, wallpaper, terminal colors and compositor effects.

ul.li: See every theme as a drawn mockup of the desktop before applying it
Try a theme for a few seconds, and go back if you do not keep it
Make a complete theme from four colors, or from a wallpaper
Start from built-in themes with light and dark versions
Switch between light and dark by time of day
Share themes as packs, and undo any change from the history

description.p: Changes are written to the configuration files of LXQt, Openbox, GTK, pcmanfm-qt, QTerminal and picom. Each change is backed up first.
